name: question
description: FR-BB22 (roadmap section 2.2) -- ports the questions AND question_translations tables from c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\BilimBaga\backend\migrations\009_questions.up.sql. The two source tables collapse into this ONE entity type, which is the single most important modelling decision here: BilimBaga used a per-locale row table (question_translations) because its Postgres schema had no other way to hold multilingual text, and REQ-301's :localized_text is exactly that mechanism at the platform layer -- blob-stored with a generated column per locale when queried: true -- so question_translations has no independent existence in this pack. category_id is :string, queried: true, required: true, holding a referenced record_id; the foreign_keys entry below (fk_question_category_id) makes it a real Postgres REFERENCES. difficulty is :enum with enum_values ["easy","medium","hard"], queried: true, required: true, ported exactly from the source CHECK. type is :enum with enum_values ["single","multiple","truefalse","likert","shorttext"], queried: true, required: true, ported exactly from the source CHECK. default_locale is :string, queried: false, required: true (source default 'kk'). status is :enum with enum_values ["draft","review","active","archived"], queried: true, required: true, ported exactly from the source CHECK. version is :integer, queried: true, required: true. stem is :localized_text (source question_translations.stem) with locales ["kk","ru","en"], search_strategy "fulltext", queried: true, required: true -- fulltext because roadmap 2.3's question list is searchable and 2.5's duplicate detection is trigram similarity over stems; this is the one field in this pack where search strategy is load-bearing rather than incidental, which is why it differs from category.name's "plain" strategy. explanation is :localized_text (source question_translations.explanation, nullable) with locales ["kk","ru","en"], search_strategy "plain", queried: false, required: false. Foreign keys: fk_question_category_id (field "category_id", references_entity "category"). Indexes: idx_question_status over status and idx_question_category_id over category_id (mirroring the source's idx_questions_status and idx_questions_category_id), plus idx_question_type over type because roadmap 2.3's list endpoint filters on it. No id, created_at, updated_at field is declared: the record subsystem mints record identity and the event store carries the audit timeline, so declaring these here would duplicate platform-owned state inside tenant content. created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) is DROPPED: an entity definition's fk_def can only reference another entity type in the same tenant's entity subsystem (references_entity is resolved through the promoted-column tables), and identity.users is a different subsystem that no fk_def can span. What replaces it: authorship is already captured by the event store -- every Letflow.Entities.Records write carries actor_id into the ENTITY_RECORD_CREATED event -- so "who authored this question" is answerable from the event stream without a duplicated, unenforceable column; no plain :string created_by field holding an unenforced user id is declared. parent_id is :string, queried: true, not required, holding the predecessor question's record_id (version lineage, ports the source's questions.parent_id UUID REFERENCES questions(id): "parent_id links a new version to its predecessor; only the latest version is active"; null = first version). The foreign_keys entry fk_question_parent_id promotes it to a nullable uuid self-referencing column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (decision 0025; inert on the soft-delete path, where the live rule is Letflow.Modules.Exam.AuthoringRules question_has_children). The authoring surface refuses a parent that does not exist (parent_not_found); the lineage rules (one successor per version, version ordering, one active version per lineage) are REQ-586 part B. Indexes: idx_question_parent_id over parent_id.
